evidence.velocity_vs_rigour: Continuously improve our analytics platform through robust modeling, testing, documentation, and engineering best practices
evidence.velocity_vs_rigour_explanation: Rigour signals (robust modeling, testing, documentation, trusted metrics) are balanced by growth/scale framing ('fast-growing operational businesses', 'scalable data products') without dominant velocity language, landing at mixed.
evidence.domain_risk: power decision-making across our 7 international markets
evidence.domain_risk_explanation: Errors would affect business decisions and product outcomes across markets but there is no financial reporting, regulatory, or compliance language, so moderate.
evidence.data_team_maturity: Continuously improve our analytics platform through robust modeling, testing, documentation, and engineering best practices
evidence.data_team_maturity_explanation: An existing analytics platform with named tooling (BigQuery, Looker, dbt/Dataform/SQLMesh) is being extended and improved, not built from zero, indicating a mid-maturity data function.
evidence.jd_authorship: Build and maintain scalable, production-grade data models and analytics foundations that power decision-making across our 7 international markets
evidence.jd_authorship_explanation: Specific tools (BigQuery, Looker, dbt/Dataform/SQLMesh), scale context (7 international markets), and precise responsibilities make this clearly hiring-manager authored.
evidence.stakeholder_orientation: Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to define success metrics, evaluate product outcomes, and turn data into actionable insights
evidence.stakeholder_orientation_explanation: Product Managers and product outcome measurement are named as the primary partnership, placing this in the product orientation.
evidence.autonomy_level: Enable self-service analytics through trusted metrics, reusable semantic models, and scalable data products
evidence.autonomy_level_explanation: The role owns building platform-level semantic models and self-service infrastructure (strategic) while also partnering with PMs to translate their specific questions (execution), producing a mixed autonomy level.
evidence.ai_role: Leverage AI and modern analytics tooling to accelerate insight generation, improve analytics workflows, and enable stakeholders to interact with data more effectively
evidence.ai_role_explanation: The candidate is expected to use AI tooling to accelerate their own analytics work, making this ai_user rather than ai_enabler (no mention of building AI-consuming data infrastructure).
evidence.testing_framing: Continuously improve our analytics platform through robust modeling, testing, documentation, and engineering best practices
evidence.testing_framing_explanation: Testing appears in responsibilities alongside modeling and documentation as something the candidate owns and continuously improves, not just a listed tool skill.
evidence.loss_aversion_framing_explanation: The JD is framed entirely in capability and delivery terms (building, enabling, leveraging) with no risk, compliance, or trust-recovery language.
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix: Build and maintain scalable, production-grade data models and analytics foundations
evidence.greenfield_vs_fix_explanation: Responsibilities mix building new semantic models/data products with maintaining and improving an existing analytics platform, giving a mixed signal.
evidence.work_arrangement: You work remotely (Germany-wide), with offices in Hamburg, Berlin or Munich
